_note: A0 (V6.1.217): the ONE list of what a guest may read from SMT's account feed. Read by smt/explain/account_snapshot.py (writes the public account.json) AND by functions/api/public_account.js (the Worker serves only these fields, whatever daemon wrote the file). A field not named here stays founder-only.
_closed_row_note: operator 10-07: a guest sees no stop, target or hold time. A CLOSED row also drops its open time (open + close stamps give away a setup's clock); an OPEN row keeps it.
_copy_setups_note: the paper COPIES (playbook.SHADOW_SETUPS, a test pins it) — never public, even in setup_totals
